bio: DJ and beach-club host. Sunset sets, neon pool nights and the crowd's first hands in the air. Adults only.
avatar: Portrait of a man in his early 30s with a trimmed beard and headphones around his neck, colourful stage light on his face, open linen shirt, shoulders-up, photographic, fictional person
banner: Ultra-wide panoramic photograph of a beach club DJ booth at sunset with laser lights and a crowd silhouette on the sand, subject across the middle band, cinematic

videos.title: Sunset set, hands in the air
videos.description: The first drop of the night with the sun going down.
videos.still: Wide photograph of a crowd in silhouette with hands raised on a beach at sunset facing a DJ booth with lights, orange sky, no readable faces, no text
videos.motion: The crowd sways with raised hands, stage lights sweep across, the sun sinks, slow camera push-in.

videos.title: Mixer close-up, fader slide

videos.title: Pool party, neon after dark
videos.description: Neon colours on the water and silhouettes dancing at the edge.

videos.motion: Neon light ripples across the pool surface and silhouettes dance, slow camera tilt, pulsing glow.

videos.title: Soundcheck, empty club
videos.description: Before the doors open: an empty floor, one spotlight and a bass test.

videos.motion: Haze drifts through the spotlight beam and lights sweep slowly, gentle camera push-in.
